lessons.title: disaggregated_encoder e2e: decode engine crashes with batch_norm eps=0.0 (upstream FusedInputNorm x torch 2.11)
lessons.symptom: test_disaggregated_encoder[1-Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct]: the ENCODE server becomes healthy, but the DECODE (EC consumer) server never does. Its EngineCore dies in profile_run with "ValueError: batch_norm eps must be positive, but got 0.0" (vision.py F.batch_norm), right after "Encoder cache will be initialized with a budget of 16384 tokens, and profiled with 1 video items". The test then spins its health-wait loop (READY spam) until the suite timeout SIGKILLs it (exit -9). Same crash on the a3-2 PR CI matrix and on vllm main 073c510c/0820125ae.
lessons.root_cause: vllm main PR #50411 ("Fused mm preprocess normalisation on the Device", merged 2026-08-06) rewrote Qwen2_5_VLInputNorm.forward to call F.batch_norm with HARDCODED eps=0.0 (vllm/model_executor/models/vision.py:727). torch 2.11 rejects eps<=0 unconditionally (torch/nn/functional.py:2844); torch 2.12+ only checks during training, so upstream vllm CI (torch 2.12+) passes while vllm-ascend containers (torch 2.11) crash deterministically. Still present at vllm main HEAD as of 2026-08-10.
fix_guidance: vllm-ascend workaround: create vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_vision.py that monkeypatches FusedInputNorm.forward to replace eps=0.0 with eps=1e-5 (eval mode, result is identical). Reference implementation (PR vllm-ascend/vllm-ascend#13477):

```python
# vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_vision.py
import contextlib
import torch

def _patched_fused_input_norm_forward(self, grid_thw, visual_dtype):
    if self.is_identity:
        return grid_thw.to(visual_dtype)
    assert grid_thw.ndim == 2
    patches, size = grid_thw.shape
    patch_size = size // self.channel
    grid_thw = grid_thw.view(patches, self.channel, patch_size)
    grid_thw = torch.nn.functional.batch_norm(
        grid_thw.to(self.dtype),
        running_mean=self.running_mean,
        running_var=self.running_var,
        weight=self.weight,
        bias=self.bias,
        training=False,
        eps=1e-5,
    )
    return grid_thw.view(patches, size).to(visual_dtype)

def install_patch():
    from vllm.model_executor.models.vision import FusedInputNorm
    FusedInputNorm.forward = _patched_fused_input_norm_forward

with contextlib.suppress(ImportError):
    install_patch()
```
Register the patch in vllm_ascend/patch/platform/__init__.py (follow patch_fused_moe / patch_mla_prefill_backend precedent).
Do NOT treat this as an env flake: it recurs on every run/matrix (vllm main + torch 2.11).
The test also requires the vllm-ascend/mm_request modelscope dataset + Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct cached on the runner; without them it fails earlier at collection/model load.
lessons.example: PR vllm-ascend/vllm-ascend#13477 used this exact patch and the test passed. Run 31322838012 rerun: decode engine crashed at profile_run with the eps error, but the old error_logs tail-cut only showed READY spam, so the adapter could not see the cause — fixed by error-excerpt extraction in main2main_flow.
